elements.name: Only Name
elements.note: type is ABSENT in the body; a reader may infer it from the directory or serve it untyped, but must not invent timestamps

elements.name: Declared Elsewhere
elements.note: sits in elements/character/ and declares location — the body wins

elements.name: Extension Carrier
elements.note: x_probe_note must survive a read-write round trip unchanged

elements.name: Wandering Pin
elements.note: MAPLESS by design — no map, no element. Must not crash, must not be given one

legacy_elements.name: Legacy Map
legacy_elements.note: lives in spatial/map/ — NOT normative. A reader that covers only elements/ is conforming and reports 6; a legacy-tolerant reader (atlas) reports 7

reader_report_shape.found: count of elements[] your reader loaded
reader_report_shape.found_legacy: count of legacy_elements[] your reader additionally loaded (0 is conforming)
reader_report_shape.deleted_or_renamed: files your reader wrote to, moved or removed — should be empty for a read
